nodes.label: Camera Points (oCamera_Point / oCamera_Point_Weak)
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Radius-based points pan the camera between player and point depending on distance; weak points give a softer nudge.

nodes.label: Climbing Mechanic (cut)
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Worked well but changed level design too much; cut instead of choosing climb-anywhere vs marked ledges.

nodes.label: Dialogue String Commands (parDialogue/Draw_73)
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Per-dialogue-block command string (s shake, a anim, f facing, t timer, h/v speed) lets dialogue drive object animation.

nodes.label: Letterbox Effect (oControl/Draw_73)
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Placed in Draw End to always render on top, which later overdrew UI text.

nodes.label: oControl
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Catch-all object: world editor, planet backgrounds, music, global variables and features that didn't fit elsewhere.

nodes.label: oEo (EO floating companion)
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Lowercase 'o' name caused typos; evolved from shoulder cannon to AI-like companion as game shifted from combat to story.

nodes.label: Player Draw States via dlg_anim (oPlayer/Draw_0)
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Layered if/else chain choosing sprite instead of a real state machine; author recommends switch statements.

nodes.label: post mortem, ante vitam
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Future NYKRA to take a slower, more thoughtful approach (Tolkien inspiration).

nodes.label: set_game_screen
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Called on save open/close and every room entry to set window mode, camera, view scale; heavy and repeatedly flushes draw/texture.

nodes.label: Multi-Tool System (culled scope)
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Torch and other tools trimmed during scope reduction.

nodes.label: Control / Camera / Player / World Foundation
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Foundation must be set before structures are built; lighting and dialogue matter later.

nodes.label: EO 32x32 Surface Pixelation
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Drawing rotated sprites to a 32x32 surface keeps pixels crisp, avoiding rotated pixels/mixels.

nodes.label: Fixed 60 FPS Game Speed
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Fixed rate preferred over delta-time; makes timers and animations simpler.

nodes.label: Black Surface + Subtractive Blend Lighting
nodes.author: ENDESGA
nodes.rationale: Lights drawn additively onto a black surface then blended with gpu_set_blendmode_ext(bm_zero,bm_subtract); sky lighting was hard, so no day/night cycle without shaders.

nodes.label: Trailing buffer padding & deleted slot quirk
nodes.norm_label: trailing buffer padding & deleted slot quirk
nodes.rationale: map_save uses buffer_create(grow) + buffer_save, saving full capacity not buffer_tell, so 66 of 183 files are zero-padded to power-of-2 sizes.

nodes.label: GameMaker runtime licensing constraints (Free vs Professional, GMRT)
nodes.norm_label: gamemaker runtime licensing constraints (free vs professional, gmrt)

nodes.label: Explicit policy for invalid sprite/unknown object payloads
nodes.norm_label: explicit policy for invalid sprite/unknown object payloads

nodes.label: Light model delegation decision
nodes.rationale: A light model may run milestones 3.0-3.2 but not YYC event reconstruction, mask/tile fidelity or transactional save safety.

nodes.label: Withdrawn native tag-4/tag-5 inversion claim
nodes.rationale: Native _save_type routes number/int32/int64 through tag 1/f32 and bool through tag 4; chapter_4/CONTROL anim1 04 01 is a valid true bool, not an overrun.

nodes.label: Fix: save_game/load_game restricted to ROOMS/<CURRENTROOM>.SAVE
nodes.rationale: Native save_game/load_game only touch ROOMS/*.SAVE and never call load_CHARACTER/load_CONTROL; global loads stay in oControl/Other_4.

nodes.label: Mandatory safety and scope rules
nodes.rationale: Protect original zip, RuntimeBaseline, templates and profiles; reconstructed code still writes old format to PROFILES/.

nodes.label: Legacy profiles unsupported decision
nodes.rationale: User confirmed old saves need not work; avoids ambiguous legacy parsing while never deleting old files.

nodes.label: V1 length-framed typed value tags (f64, string, array, bool, int64)
nodes.norm_label: v1 length-framed typed value tags (f64, string, array, bool, int64)
nodes.rationale: Length framing lets unknown tags be skipped and avoids the ambiguous legacy array tags; int64 tag preserves integer precision.

nodes.label: No Build/Test/Lint or CI in Excerpt
nodes.norm_label: no build/test/lint or ci in excerpt
nodes.rationale: Compiling requires the complete project and GameMaker, so changes are verified by diff review and event/metadata pairing.

nodes.label: NYKRA.zip (compiled itch.io build)
nodes.rationale: Original editable source was lost; author authorized reconstruction and bug fixing from the compiled build. 374 MB, git-ignored due to GitHub 100 MB limit.

nodes.label: RuntimeBaseline (NYKRA.exe, data.win)
nodes.rationale: data.win (292 MB) git-ignored; NYKRA.exe (35 MB) tracked.

nodes.label: NYKRA: Before Source Excerpt (no root .yyp)
nodes.rationale: Repository is only an excerpt; .yy files reference omitted resources, so it cannot be built or launched as checked out.

nodes.label: Original GML Excerpts (repo root)
nodes.rationale: Only original-source GML in existence; read-only reference unless asked.

nodes.label: ReconstructedGML phase1_core (map_load/map_save/goto_map/save)
nodes.rationale: Pre-2.3 argument-style script bodies; do not paste blindly into 2.3+ scripts.

nodes.label: Sprite Frame Offsets from Texture-Page Entries
nodes.norm_label: sprite frame offsets from texture-page entries
nodes.rationale: 2,340 of 2,938 PNG frames differ from declared canvas; sort frame suffixes numerically.

nodes.label: Unittest Suite (save_load_compat, save_v1_format, phase3_level_probe, phase3_tileset)
nodes.rationale: Tests check fixtures and structure only; they don't certify GML behaviour or rendering.

nodes.label: validate_formats.py
nodes.rationale: Rewrites Tools/phase1_validation_report.json, so check git diff after running.

nodes.label: NYKRA_VerticalSlice.yyp Test Project
nodes.rationale: Partial project with probe objects (oLevelProbe, oSpriteProbe, oLeavesProbe), room rmMAIN and TILES tileset; compiles in VM.

nodes.label: Never Modify Baseline Artifacts (verify SHA-256)
nodes.rationale: NYKRA.zip, RuntimeBaseline, Included Files and NativeAnalysis outputs are evidence; copy fixtures and verify hashes.

nodes.label: Milestone-by-Milestone Workflow
nodes.rationale: Add only assets each milestone needs; stop for user validation; don't advance to Phase 4 alone; report blocker after two failed repairs; one commit per logical change.

nodes.label: No Guessing / No Silent No-ops Rule
nodes.norm_label: no guessing / no silent no-ops rule
nodes.rationale: No legacy profile import, no guessing ambiguous save values, no no-op replacements, no blind skipping of unknown payload bytes.

nodes.label: Save Directory Sandbox Rule
nodes.rationale: Reconstructed save code writes PROFILES/ in the old format; keep sandbox on and use a distinct project name so %LOCALAPPDATA% doesn't collide with the real game.

nodes.label: YYC Build Cannot Be Decompiled from data.win
nodes.norm_label: yyc build cannot be decompiled from data.win
nodes.rationale: Shipped build is YYC (native), so logic must come from Ghidra pseudocode of NYKRA.exe; Actions:null in objects-metadata.json means no recovered code, not an empty event.

nodes.label: GML Event / .yy Metadata Alignment Rule
nodes.rationale: Event sources (Create_0, Step_*, Draw_*) must match .yy event lists; exact resource names and casing preserved (oEo intentional).
